name: mf_fno_transfer_film
description: Transfer-learning MF-FNO (pretrain LF -> fine-tune HF; Lyu 2023) with the condition vector X injected via per-block FiLM affine modulation instead of constant-channel concatenation. Identical backbone + transfer schedule to the frozen mf_fno_transfer_bar; the ONLY change is concat->FiLM conditioning, so the comparison isolates the conditioning mechanism. FiLM conditions on X only (m never enters; MF lives in the schedule), distinguishing it from fno_coreg_conditioned (FiLM on m, X still concatenated).
